messages:
maria: PTAL — addressed the serialization endianness nit from review, added a unit test that covers little/big endian streams and a short comment explaining why we choose little-endian for the network wire format. pushed branch feat/serde-endian-fix. CI started but one flaky integration job failed, rerunning.

omar: thanks — looks small. can you squash the tiny fixups into a single commit before merge?

maria: yeah I can squash. will force-push once CI reruns. initial diff is literally 6 lines in serializer + test.

ci-bot: Re-run queued: build #1245 — https://ci.example.com/build/1245 (maria triggered).

mila: quick question: does this change the on-disk format for persisted kv snapshots or only the transient network encoding?

maria: only network encoding for streaming RPCs, no on-disk snapshot change. added a note in the PR description to clarify and a small comment in snapshot_reader to avoid confusion.

omar: one more approver needed. @sam can you take a look when you have a moment?

sam: will do a pass this afternoon, looks straightforward from a cursory glance.

maria: force-pushed a squashed commit (feat/serde-endian-fix -> origin). updated PR title and removed WIP note.

ci-bot: Build #1245: all unit tests passed. flaky-suite/integration-3 still red (known flake). retrying flaky job.

mila: for the merge window: we can wait for flaky-suite green, or we can do a canary deploy behind the new rollout flag. which do we prefer?

omar: prefer canary so we don't block the release. add a rollout flag to the PR and document the canary plan (50% traffic -> monitor errors/cpu for 30m -> 100%).

maria: added a rollout flag (config/feature_flags.yaml) and a short plan in the PR description. PTAL again @omar @sam — I annotated the steps and rollback.

sam: LGTM. left one nit on a comment string but not blocking. :thumbsup:

omar: LGTM as well. I'll merge once flaky-suite is green or use the manual canary override per the plan if it stays flaky. thanks!
